title: Why knowledge was retained
boundary: Current published knowledge. Stage units and scopes differ; totals are not a funnel.
limits: Up to 30 examples, 20 jobs and 100 diagnostics. No source discovery or model calls.
incomplete: Metadata was unreadable or exceeded limits. These totals are incomplete.
scoped: Sample coverage does not establish eligibility across all sources.
staging: Stopped and failed staging is provisional and excluded from current totals. Job links open import progress and retry controls.
coverage: Outcomes recorded for {count} saved session parts.
unknown: No sufficient eligibility evidence. Zero does not mean no eligible content exists.
reviewed_zero: Saved extraction outcomes produced no current records here. Known routing appears below; model omissions and unprocessed sources remain possible.
unresolved: Pending work or unresolved errors remain. Zero cannot prove absence of eligible content.
filtering_unknown: Published-operation filtering counts were not recorded.
filtering_input: {count} input messages in the published operation.
transient_content: A temporary command or acknowledgement has no durable knowledge.
runtime_content: Runtime, tool or generated context was filtered from durable input.
tool_content: Tool output lacks relevant verification evidence.
outside_selected_domains: Candidate is outside selected knowledge domains.
temporary_request: A temporary request is not a lasting personal attribute.
project_choice: A project choice is not a general personal attribute.
preference_claim: A preference claim belongs outside current personal facts.
dated_observation: A dated observation belongs to historical context.
uncertain_personal_claim: Candidate does not establish a reliable personal claim.
nonliteral_personal_claim: A hypothetical or quoted profile does not establish a personal fact.
merge_not_applied: Review did not establish a safe canonical merge.
review_history: Candidate was routed to historical or project context.
review_discarded: Review rejected this candidate for durable personal knowledge.
review_split: Review split reusable knowledge from project context.
reviewed: Review was recorded; safe detailed reason metadata is unavailable.
no_candidate: Extraction produced no candidate; eligible content might still exist.
invalid_evidence: A processing or validation attempt failed; safe detailed metadata is unavailable.
recovered_attempt: A later saved extraction in the same run repaired this attempt.
source_unavailable: Source reference unavailable in published knowledge.
request_timeout: The model request timed out. Open the processing job to review retry options.
invalid_source: Candidate evidence cited a source that could not be verified.
provider_unavailable: The provider was temporarily unavailable or rate limited. Review retry options in the processing job.
invalid_format: The model result was incomplete or did not match the required format.
processing_failed: A processing attempt failed. Safe detailed reason metadata is unavailable; review the processing job.
user_suppressed: Your correction suppresses generated records from this evidence. Review your knowledge corrections to restore or revise them.
